# The construction-retain matrix: struct-literal FIELD KIND x VALUE SHAPE,
# verdicts per compiler (native selfhost). Regenerate with
# FERN_CONSTRUCTION_RETAIN_DUMP=1 (and -v). Exits match native on every cell
# and the underflow guard is 0 everywhere: every divergence below is a
# LEAK-direction floor — an uncounted share the release side then cannot
# reclaim — which is the killer-drops wave's burn-down list. Native is clean
# on all 35 cells: every share is counted there and fields drop at the box's
# rc-death.
#
# The shape axis: fresh = inline literal/ctor (sole-owned, no-inc baseline);
# local = bare ident of a fresh local, both claims live; param = bare ident
# of a param the caller keeps; fieldread = q.f off a live sibling holder
# (the flatten__RewriteCtx class); call = producer result.
#
# READ THE `local` ROWS AS COMPOUND: the shape ends with a second holder aliased
# to a third name (`var q: P = P { f: mkv(..) }; var p: P = q;`), so a row stays
# `leak` while EITHER the field share or the alias bind is uncounted. Both
# halves of `enum__local` are now clean, and each needed its own fix — the field
# share (self_host_enum_field_share_test.go) and the value-block borrow read
# (self_host_match_expr_borrow_test.go), since that cell reads its field through
# a `match` EXPRESSION and the apparent capture refused the alias bind.
#
# So a `local` row that still reads leak is not evidence of one shared floor.
# Measure the halves separately before attributing it.
#
# The whole `struct` row is clean as of the counted-sink narrowing: a struct
# handed to a struct-literal FIELD keeps its free-eligibility, because that
# position retains unconditionally and the exit sweep's field walk is now
# rc-gated so only the owner that finds rc 1 performs it. A SELF-APPEND or an
# ARRAY-LITERAL element of a container that earned its element walk is counted
# the same way, keyed on the element SITE ("APOWNED:") so a retired slot cannot
# fall through the gate. The remaining CONTAINER sinks — an append or literal
# whose container is uncredited, `with`, a tuple element, a variant payload — are
# still refused: nothing retains there, so granting them releases a box that was
# never inc'd. TestSelfHostContainerSinkMatrixX86_64 is the grid for that axis.
str__fresh          clean clean  fresh concat is Owned, handed over uncounted and dropped
str__local          clean clean  counted: the struct-lit field retain fires whenever the store is not a MOVE, and the source now keeps the "STR:" credit that balances it
str__param          clean clean  counted: param_counted_of proves the callee's every use is a counted store, so the caller keeps the release its own creation owes
str__fieldread      clean clean  counted share: str_field_share_read retains the read and flips both holders to FLDCHECKED
str__call           clean clean  producer result is Owned
str_arr__fresh      clean clean  fresh string[] literal owned by the holder
str_arr__local      clean clean  counted: the field store retains whenever it is not a MOVE, and the source keeps the DEEP "SARR:" credit so its element walk survives a path that never builds the holder
str_arr__param      clean clean  same tier, DEEP class: the callee's store retains the buffer and __fern_str_arr_free's rc gate leaves the element walk to whichever owner reaches rc 1
str_arr__fieldread  clean leak   the RewriteCtx shape, string[] flavor
str_arr__call       clean clean  producer result owned
arr_i32__fresh      clean clean  fresh scalar-array literal
arr_i32__local      clean clean  the #3292 dup: bare scalar-array ident is retained and balanced
arr_i32__param      clean clean  same dup, param origin
arr_i32__fieldread  clean clean  counted: the literal retains the read and the source keeps its deep drop
arr_i32__call       clean clean  producer result owned
struct__fresh       clean clean  fresh Inner literal
struct__local       clean clean  counted-sink forgiveness taken; the rc-gated sweep lets both owners release
struct__param       clean clean  param bare ident retained, param owns nothing to strand
struct__fieldread   clean clean  counted: unconditional nested-struct retain + kept source drop
struct__call        clean clean  strict-fresh call result owned outright
enum__fresh         clean clean  fresh variant ctor owned
enum__local         clean clean  field share counted, and the match-expr read no longer reads as a capture
enum__param         clean clean  counted: the ECNT tier proves the callee's every use is a counted store, and a bare `match (p)` scrutinee is not one — so the payload can never be handed out
enum__fieldread     clean clean  q.f read retained; the holder's own ctor-call is ENUM:-owned, both decs balance
enum__call          clean clean  strict-fresh enum call result ("ENUM:" registry) owned outright
enum_arr__fresh     clean clean  fresh [E.A(..)] literal: __enum_arr_elems_drop walks the payloads
enum_arr__local     clean clean  counted: the field share keeps the source its rc-gated walk
enum_arr__param     clean leak   param enum-array, same uncounted handover
enum_arr__fieldread clean clean  counted: the field read is retained and both NODEEP markers drop with it
enum_arr__call      clean clean  producer result owned, payload walk releases it
struct_arr__fresh   clean clean  fresh [Inner{..}] literal owned, deep-dropped
struct_arr__local   clean clean  counted: the field share keeps the source its rc-gated walk
struct_arr__param   clean leak   param Inner[]
struct_arr__fieldread clean clean counted: array-of-struct retain + kept source drop
struct_arr__call    clean clean  producer result owned
